incidents.symptom: With the proven FD and fgraph=4, only XNU mapWindow(0xD0000000, 64 KiB, WC) was added after graph configuration; no memory read or write, no APM MEM_MAP, no period or amplifier operation. Fastboot boot returned OK but CDC did not enumerate within 90 seconds and no Fastboot appeared. Mapping itself is a strong suspect, but without a stage sample the exact stop point is not proven.
incidents.last_stable: Known-good FD fgraph=3 control: stage 13, graph phase 18, CDC PING
incidents.next: Do not reuse 0xD0000000 fixed mapping; identify an owned DMA buffer or a verified DSP-addressable IOVA route.

incidents.symptom: Known-good FD plus opt-in fgraph=4 fixed low-DRAM PCM map: CDC serial enumerated at 38s, but control HELLO/PING timed out repeatedly and capture had no new kernel log. No map reply was observed; cannot distinguish the address access from another graph/transport stall.
incidents.last_stable: R-GRAPH-04 and known-good-FD fgraph=3 control run
incidents.next: Do not repeat fgraph=4. Restore known-good image; isolate mapWindow, write and MEM_MAP into separate bounded stages with a control response between them.

incidents.symptom: With the UEFI source reverted but firmware rebuilt, an opt-in XNU fixed 0xD0000000 PCM map probe image returned fastboot boot OK; no CDC after 90 seconds and no Fastboot enumeration. No stage or map result could be read, so the failure point is unknown. The fixed-map code was removed from the active source.
incidents.next: Use the FD extracted from R-GRAPH-04 for an XNU-only boot-chain control test before attempting another PCM map.

incidents.symptom: With a new 64 KiB Fuxi Audio PCM reservation added to the UEFI memory map, fastboot boot returned OK but the owner reported UEFI boot hang; no CDC or Fastboot enumerated. The source reservation was reverted and the firmware rebuilt.
incidents.next: Do not reuse this image or add a UEFI reservation for the audio path.

incidents.symptom: The GRAPH_OPEN-only image booted and answered one DIAGSTATUS (page 1 value 7), then CDC disappeared. No graph-open result was read. The device later enumerated in Fastboot.
incidents.raw_capture: no graph result; the only retained sample was page 1 before the disconnect
incidents.note: The graph-open code path is disabled by default after this event. Do not re-enable it without a host-side packet/CDC isolation test.
incidents.next: review the graph-open builder and dspReceive interception; verify packet generation and response handling off-device before another boot

incidents.symptom: CDC USB disconnected again; the device enumerated in Fastboot. Retained capture ends at Metal 105/105 and GOP 42/42; no panic line was captured.
incidents.raw_capture: not completed: the 40-byte APM-command-header query image reset before DIAGSTATUS could be read
incidents.note: This image changed GET_SPF_STATE to the Linux q6apm 40-byte form (24-byte GPR header + 16-byte APM command header). It reset to Fastboot. Do not reuse it as a baseline.
incidents.next: revert to the stable 24-byte header-only query and treat ADSP_EFAILED (status 1) as the observed APM answer; do not retry the 40-byte form without a separate stability investigation

incidents.symptom: CDC USB disconnected about 3 seconds after the collector attached; the device then enumerated in Fastboot. No panic line was retained in the capture.
incidents.raw_capture: none: no GPRQ/GPRR hex lines were present before the disconnect
incidents.note: The experimental image increased the GPR probe to 100 queries over 60 s and added raw kprintf. The reset occurred near the extended GPR window. Do not reuse this image as a baseline.
incidents.next: revert to the R-GPR-02 50-query/20-second timing, log only the first request and first reply, and verify CDC stability before another raw-capture attempt
